name: ability-patch
effect: This item will change a Pokémon's ability from its standard ability to its Hidden Ability. As of Pokémon Scarlet & Violet, it will also change a Pokémon's Ability from a Hidden Ability to a normal Ability.
shortEffect: This item will change a Pokémon's ability from its standard ability to its Hidden Ability. As of Pokémon Scarlet & Violet, it will also change a Pokémon's Ability from a Hidden Ability to a normal Ability.

flavorTextEntries.text: A patch that allows a Pokémon with a regular Ability to have a rare Ability.
